events.verdict: Strus (CLE) extends his forearm and initiates contact to Edwards' (PHI) body, which affects his play at the basket
Yabusele (PHI) does not establish a legal position in Mitchell's (CLE) path when the body contact occurs after his gather, which affects Mitchell's driving shot attempt.
Jerome (CLE) reaches for the ball and the contact with George's (PHI) left arm is marginal.
George (PHI) hooks his arm around Allen's (CLE) side during the drive, which affects Allen's ability to defend.

Instant replay is triggered to review if Mitchell (CLE) is inside the RA as contact occurs with George (PHI) during the driving shot attempt. After communicating with the Replay Center, the call on the floor is confirmed. The play originates outside the LDB. Mitchell is the secondary defender and does not establish a legal guarding position outside of the RA prior to contact occurring with George during the driving shot attempt.
Yabusele (PHI) and Allen (CLE) mutually engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Jerome (CLE) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Philadelphia correctly retains possession.
Strus (CLE) briefly grasps George's (PHI) right arm and marginal contact occurs during the drive.
Strus (CLE) cleanly dislodges the ball away from George (PHI) after his gather.
George (PHI) deflects the ball away from Allen (CLE) and is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds. Cleveland correctly retains possession.
Gordon (PHI) continues moving Jerome (CLE) off his spot off-ball, delivering more than marginal body contact.
George (PHI) and Mitchell (CLE) come together as Mitchell releases the pass and the body contact is marginal.
Garland (CLE) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Jerome (CLE) signals for a timeout within 5 seconds.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Jerome (CLE) throws the pass out of bounds. PHI is correctly awarded possession.
Garland (CLE) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Maxey (PHI) veers slightly toward Garland (CLE) during the inbounds and the contact that occurs when the two players come together, is marginal.
Mitchell (CLE) commits a take foul on Edwards (PHI).
